top_signals.title: Argentina’s $24 Billion LNG Dream Bets On Milei's Model Enduring
top_signals.summary: Argentina is trying to push through one of the biggest energy investments ever in Latin America. The $24 billion plan to produce vast quantities of liquefied shale gas is a key part of efforts to turn Argentina into a significant world supplier. But while locals hope for enduring prosperity, fears linger over whether construction jobs will vanish once terminals go live—and whether heavy industry will threaten the gulf’s protected right whales. Jonathan Gilbert reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Turkey Fund Investors Protest in Ankara Over Trapped Savings
top_signals.summary: Protesters saying their investments were tied up in liquidated Turkish funds demonstrated at the market regulator’s headquarters on Thursday, adding more political backlash to a scandal engulfing the country’s markets.
